record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: R64 realized-capital feedback is now contained in ggen-marketplace default history. Exact qualified head 9b2df357aa56148e8f2cbe1d4222cc2c94758a6e merged as ca8b736491a34ca84bda0b4a1e4f4cc0ca99ea96 with containment proven. New lawful frontier: (1) R65 realized-capital reinvestment selection/controller from observed R64 yield; (2) predicted R63 allocation vs realized R64 calibration; (3) cross-repository realization-return ingestion for ggen and chatgpt-cloud-elixir; (4) consumer replication remains the weakest observed multiplier because prior durable memory has R_observed=1.
